name: Drider Shadowspinner

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description:
Leather armor is sturdier than cloth armor. It protects vital areas with multiple layers of boiled-leather plates, while covering the limbs with supple leather that provides a small amount of protection.
	Magic appears at higher item levels, and grants higher armor bonuses than its mundane counterparts. Leather armor grants +3 AC at levels 16-25, and +4 AC at levels 26-30.

description: Creatures larger than Medium take up more than 1 square. For instance, an ogre takes up a space that is 2 squares by 2 squares. Most Large and larger creatures also have a reach greater than 1, which means they can make melee attacks against creatures that aren’t adjacent to them. A creature’s basic body shape usually determines its reach; a Large ogre has a reach of 2, but a Large horse has a reach of 1.

traits.name: Combat Advantage
traits.details: The drider deals 2d6 extra necrotic damage against any target granting combat advantage to it.

traits.name: Shifting Shadows
traits.details: If the drider ends a move on its turn at least 3 squares from where it started the move, it gains partial concealment until the end of its next turn.

hit.description: necrotic damage, and the drider ends any mark on it and can shift 1 square.
The target is restrained until it escapes (DC 21) or teleports.

effect.description: Close burst 1. The burst creates a zone that lasts until the end of the drider’s next turn. The cloud blocks line of sight for all creatures except the drider. Any creature other than the drider is blinded while entirely within the cloud.

hit.description: The target grants combat advantage and cannot benefit from invisibility or concealment until the end of the drider’s next turn.
